# Cerberus React component API

> Generated API references for @cerberus/react components: parts, props, recipe variants, data attributes and keyboard support. Each component also has a JSON spec (`<key>.json`) matching `component-doc-spec.schema.json`.

## Components

- [Accordion](accordion.md): The Accordion component is a versatile UI element that allows users to expand and collapse sections of content.
- [Admonition](admonition.md): The Admonition component is a versatile UI element that can be used to display important information, warnings, or notes in a visually distinct manner.
- [Avatar](avatar.md): The Avatar component is a versatile UI element that allows users to have a visual representation of their presence within an application.
- [Button](button.md): The Button component provides a visual indicator for a user to make an action of sorts, commonly used in forms, menus, and popovers.
- [Carousel](carousel.md): The Carousel component is a versatile UI element that allows users to navigate through a slideshow style set of "pages" which contain images.
